name: io.github.Servosity/xero-mcp
title: Xero MCP
description: Every Xero Accounting read plus a local SQLite ledger  -  aging, reconciliation, and GL tie-out

environmentVariables.name: XERO_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Set the XERO_ACCESS_TOKEN credential for the Xero MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: XERO_AUTHORIZATION_URL
environmentVariables.description: Authorization endpoint the login flow opens. Change it only if Xero moves the endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: XERO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Xero API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: XERO_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client ID of your Xero app (developer.xero.com > My Apps). Set it with the client secret to run the OAuth2 flow; leave blank if you paste an access token instead.

environmentVariables.name: XERO_OAUTH2
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Sets XERO_OAUTH2 for the Xero MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: XERO_TENANT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The Xero organisation ('tenant') GUID sent as the Xero-Tenant-Id header. Every call requires it; `connections list` returns the tenants your token can reach.

environmentVariables.name: XERO_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave the prefilled default unless your tenant uses a different token endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: XERO_NO_CONFIG_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to config.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.
